description.value:
Cost 2 Conviction

Area 20-foot emanation, fixed where you cast it

Duration 1 minute

The Oath becomes ground. Allies in the area, your Ward included, gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against Strikes by any creature you have Answered this encounter, and they can't be forcibly moved out of the area. The area doesn't move with you; leave it and it stands without you. This does not extend The Answer to the allies in it — that is what Ascend the Oath does at 20th.

cinderfall.incomplete: No roll option or predicate tracks 'a specific enemy this actor has already Answered this encounter' -- a dynamic, per-creature, per-encounter list with no analog anywhere in pf2e-source (the closest real predicate shape, self:effect:<slug>, flags a condition on the caster, not a rolling list of enemy identities). No rule element restricts forced movement conditioned on remaining inside a fixed, non-following battlefield area either.
